messages.content: I’ll lock in the checked day-ahead book: overnight regulation, up-reserve capacity through the day, charging at the negative midday price, and evening discharge. I’ll reassess energy dispatch at each watch; AS awards will remain fixed.

The battery is at 191.1 MWh at the 18:00 watch. I’m keeping the 100 MW discharge at hour 19, reducing hour 20 to 80 MW, and increasing late charging to give the end-of-day SoC target more protection against uncertain regulation drift.
